rationale: C07 supplies a concrete delegation template closely matching the child: presidential functions are assigned principally to the Secretary of Defense, while the corresponding Coast Guard functions are assigned to the Secretary of the Treasury. This distinctive Defense/Treasury split by service is materially reproduced in the child and goes beyond generic delegation boilerplate. C23 has nearly the same machinery but is earlier and less textually close than C07; C01 shares the opening delegation formula but not the military-service allocation structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby delegated to the Secretary of Defense the authority vested in the President by section 21...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense... [is] hereby authorized and directed... to perform the functions vested in the President by section 505...
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by transferring a specifically cited presidential statutory function to the Secretary of Defense.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Provided, that so much of the authority... as relates to any Reserve component of the United States Coast Guard or to retired personnel of the Regular Coast Guard is hereby delegated to the Secretary of the Treasury.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Secretary of the Treasury with respect to enlisted men of the Coast Guard and the Coast Guard Reserve, [is] hereby authorized and directed... to perform the functions vested in the President
shared_material.explanation: Both carve Coast Guard matters out of the Defense Secretary's assignment and place them with the Treasury Secretary, using substantially the same service-based jurisdictional division.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense is hereby authorized to redelegated... to the Secretaries of the Army, Navy, and Air Force such functions under this order as affect their respective services.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Defense with respect to enlisted men of the Army, the Navy, the Air Force, the Marine Corps...
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts C07's allocation of military functions among Defense, the component services, and Treasury, adding express redelegation to the service secretaries.
